summary: A Yes vote enacts an additional 1% transactions and use (sales) tax within the City of Patterson, with the revenue going to the city's general fund.

tax.text: A Yes vote approves a 1-cent sales tax increase for Patterson's general city services.
tax.quote: Measure P in Ceres could raise $9.4 million a year for city coffers, and Measure L in Patterson is projected to bring in $9 million.

tax.text: A No vote rejects the proposed 1-cent sales tax increase for Patterson's general city services.
